newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Brazil's Telebras to take Portugal Telecom stake.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Telebras to take Portugal Telecom stake.

text.p: Brazilian telecommunications concern Telebras will buy a 1.5 percent stake in Portugal Telecom in the next phase of the Portuguese group's privatisation, a spokesman for the Planning Ministry said.
"Telebras is going to take a stake of 1.5 percent in Portugal Telecom, part of the holding to be reserved for foreign investors," the spokesman said.
The next phase of the privatisation, which will see the government's stake go below 50 percent, is due to take place in late summer or early autumn.
The two companies have recently formed a joint venture -- the Alianca Atlantica -- which includes the Atlantis cable linking Europe, Africa and South America.
Portugal Telecom has long said that some shares at the privatisation will be reserved for strategic partners.
The Anglo-American Concert alliance of British Telecom and MCI is taking 1.5 percent of the Portuguese company while Spain's Telefonica is to have 3.5 percent.
